stemMarkdown: 40 litres of a 40% acid solution is mixed with 60 litres of a 60% acid solution. What is the acid concentration (in %) of the resulting mixture? (Round to 2 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Acid from the first: $16.00$ L. From the second: $36.00$ L. Total acid $= 52.00$ L in $100$ L of mixture, so the concentration is $52.0\%$.
